instruction: Set the default GNOME text editor font to 'Monospace 12' by modifying the desktop interface settings.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing monospace font to 'Monospace 12' through GNOME settings. Evaluator uses gsettings to verify monospace-font-name is set to 'Monospace 12'. Uses existing check_list metric with cache_file getter.

llm_judge_reasons: The evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement
The expected pattern "'Monospace 12'" (including single quotes) correctly matches gsettings output format which returns values wrapped in single quotes
The check_list metric (general.py:168) compiles the pattern as a regex and uses search() to find it in each line - this will correctly match the output "'Monospace 12'\n"
Single quotes have no special meaning in regex, so the pattern searches for the literal string "'Monospace 12'" which is exactly what gsettings outputs
The postconfig correctly executes the gsettings get command to retrieve the current monospace font setting
Complete coverage: the evaluator checks the exact requirement from the instruction (font set to 'Monospace 12')
